adversaries.capability: Controls model code; the model sees all evaluation images jointly inside the inherited sealed container; submits adaptively; may collude across identities. Defended for reference labels: every release is epsilon-label-DP and all releases on a privacy scope share one exact budget. Not defended for images (no image-level guarantee).

Dispatches runs and receives every released result for a host task. Sees only noisy GRADING metrics, a closed-taxonomy failure code with fixed detail text, routeVersion and the worker's durationMs; never host labels, predictions or ledger contents. Covered by the same label-DP guarantee as released results.
Writes open code and does not operate it. Receives no data, keys, seeds, telemetry or results.

Holds the labels, images, sealed-execution worker, this scorer and its privacy ledger; trusted operator. Differential privacy cannot protect data from the party that holds it, and a host can bypass or roll back the ledger.

assumptions: A1: Labels never enter the model sandbox; predictions do not depend on labels (inherited containment run by the host).
A2: Production noise is fresh (OpenDP CSPRNG) and never re-drawn for the same submission; simulation results never become production results.
A3: Every scored release on a protected host label set passes through the host's ledger; the host runs only this scorer for the task.
A4: The item set, item identifiers and item count are non-sensitive.
A5: The declared group factor g is at least the true maximum number of evaluation items per patient; patient-level protection is g times epsilon per release.
A6: No other participant-visible output depends on labels.
A7: The ledger file is not modified, replaced or rolled back outside this component.
outOfScope: A compromised or dishonest data host, scorer host or ledger file, including ledger rollback from backups.
A host deployment that bypasses this scorer or returns predictions or plaintext metrics.
Image-level, membership-level and cross-host or cross-dataset patient-level privacy.
Side channels beyond the inherited container controls, including failure codes chosen by the model and run duration.
Plaintext scoring of the public reference task on the platform, including Mode 1 uploads.
Attacks on OpenDP or the operating system's random number generator.

observations.observes: The five GRADING metrics computed from a noisy confusion table (coverage exact), or a failure code. Never labels, predictions, exact counts, noise or other participants' results.
Per run: noisy metrics or a closed-taxonomy failure code with fixed detail text, routeVersion and the worker's durationMs. No labels, predictions, item identifiers, exact counts or ledger contents.

Its own labels and images; container stdout/stderr in operator logs (inherited); a privacy ledger with released noisy metrics, predictions hashes, charged and certified epsilon. Not exact counts, plaintext metrics or noise.
Nothing: no telemetry, data, keys, seeds or results.

disclosureProfile.keyGovernance: No decryption keys or attestation roots are introduced. Production randomness comes from OpenDP's CSPRNG-backed sampler and is not stored. The guarantee rests on the data host operating the scorer and ledger as declared.

reproducible.method: A production release is not reproducible by design (fresh noise). Verifiable instead: open code and pinned dependencies, per-release OpenDP-certified epsilon in the ledger, exact ledger sums, and the reference-task fidelity experiment (statistically reproducible; bit-for-bit with the seeded simulation sampler).

permittedOperations: host-register: register privacy scope, dataset, version (labels and group factor) and task in the host ledger
host-preflight: refuse a dispatch before the model runs (task, exact routeVersion, canonical submission UUID, budget, releasability)
host-score: score the worker's predictions into noisy GRADING metrics or pass a failure code through
ledger: report label-level and patient-level epsilon spent per scope
recover: mark stale reservations FAILED_SPENT (still charged, never released)
operationalEnvelope.arithmeticPrecision: Exact integer confusion counts; exact discrete Laplace over i32 (OpenDP 0.16.0); IEEE-754 double post-processing; outputs rounded to 4 decimals; epsilon as exact rationals on a 1e-6 grid
operationalEnvelope.modelConstraints: None beyond the reference contract: read /input/index.json, write predictions.json (integer labels in [0, K-1], at most 100,000 items) to /output. GRADING tasks only. maxRuntimeSec and maxMemoryMb are the reference worker's dev-environment limits (infra/cdk environments.ts) and are enforced by the host's sealed-execution worker, not by this scorer; each host sets its own values [DECISION].

fidelityGap.measuredOn: idrid-dr-grading public labels, synthetic 'strong' prediction fixture, eps=8, mean of 5,000 releases (contributor-measured, local)
